answer: Each agent locks tokens to vouch for a new identity, and that vouch burns like an ember if the newcomer misbehaves, costing the sponsor real capital. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation with a decay curve. Reputation decays unless renewed by verified work, so a farm of fresh sybils cannot pool trust cheaply. A single honest sparrow contributing steadily outranks a thousand clones, and the network stays an oasis for genuine builders while attackers bleed stake with every fake identity. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
